messages:
raul: Hi all — I'm starting as an intern next week and want to get a head start on security setup. A couple quick Qs:
1) Do interns get YubiKeys or is it loaner-only?
2) How do I enroll the intern laptop on corp Wi-Fi (weird cert thing)?
3) Will the intern cohort be in the phishsim rotation immediately?
4) I'm using Docker for local model experiments — can I store service account creds in a local ~/.docker/config.json or do we have a vault flow?

tara: Welcome @raul :wave: Short answers: loaner YubiKey for interns by default (we can make exceptions), Wi-Fi uses machine certs, phishsim yes (we enroll newbies), and creds must go in the vault, not plaintext.

jin: Hi @raul from Security — adding a few specifics:
- YubiKey: interns get a loaner key tied to their account. If you need permanent 2FA we can request with manager approval.
- Wi-Fi: we use cert-based EAP-TLS. IT will provision a machine cert after MDM enrollment. If you want to pre-provision, open an onboarding ticket with serial + mac address.
- Docker creds: never store SA keys in plaintext. Use our Secrets CLI to fetch short-lived tokens at runtime:
```
# fetch a short-lived docker token for project "intern-sandbox"
secrets-cli get docker-token --project=intern-sandbox --ttl=1h | docker login --username _json_key --password-stdin https://index.docker.io/v1/
```
We also have a local helper that automatically rotates tokens for CI.

raul: Thanks @jin. On the Wi-Fi cert step — is there a self-serve command or GUI? I'm on a loaner MacBook we ship to interns.

it-bot: Hi @raul — IT onboarding steps here: https://onboard.redwood.internal/steps
Step 4 (Enroll device in MDM) triggers the cert provisioning. If you prefer an MDM-less local cert for testing, we don't allow that for interns with access to internal staging. Please open a ticket: https://it.redwood.internal/tickets new ticket type = "intern device enrolment".

tara: I'll attach the loaner YubiKey and MDM checklist to your onboarding packet. Also ping your manager to approve any longer-term key assignment.

phishsim-bot: Scheduled phish simulation enrollment: raul added to "interns-rolling" cohort. First simulated phish will be sent ~7 business days after first_message_ts. Failure triggers the 20-minute remediation micro-training.

jin: One policy note re: Docker runtimes — do NOT bind-mount /root/.ssh or mount host credentials into containers. Use the ephemeral secrets flow above. We can whitelist specific registries per-project if needed. If you need staging access to sensitive artifacts, we require an NDA addendum + manager approval.

raul: Got it — I'll open the IT ticket and ping my manager. Any ETA for the loaner YubiKey shipping?

tara: YubiKeys ship same-day if the ticket is created before 2pm PT; otherwise next business day. I'll DM you tracking once I create the request. :truck:

raul: Amazing, thanks everyone — this clears things up. I'll wait for the DM and open the ticket now. :thumbsup:
